about: Limits for scripts/bench.ps1 -Budgets. CI fails only on SizeBytes (deterministic for a toolchain); the rest are reported. Set from the medians of 5 rounds x 60 s idle on the machine below, with headroom: size ~3.5% (compiler updates), counts and leaks tight, memory ~20%, timing and CPU ~1.5-2x (they depend on the machine). Test copies log every tick to a file, which is included in the idle CPU and write numbers. Raise a limit only with a measured reason, in the same change.
measured: 2026-10-15, Intel i9-14900K, 64 GB, Intel UHD 770, Windows 11 Pro 26300, Rust 1.98.1: unseat.exe 1,294,848 bytes; idle 220 Mcycles/min, 38.6 MB private; 46.4 MB after every window; 0 handle growth; restart 91 ms
